profile_text.body:
Twilio is a public company headquartered in San Francisco, California, traded under the ticker TWLO, and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001447669. Its website describes a platform of APIs for SMS, RCS, voice, and email, combined with conversational AI and identity verification. The company says the platform connects communication channels, customer context, and AI in one place, and that it is built for engagement in what it calls the agentic era.

On AI, Twilio describes conversational AI that lets humans and AI agents work together across channels, with agents drawing on internal knowledge and real-time data. The site says agents hand off to a human when complexity or customer intent calls for it, and that conversations transfer with full context so customers do not repeat themselves. Twilio presents this as orchestration of context-rich conversations across channels, sold on flexible plans with pay-as-you-go pricing.

The company's legal exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 270 cases. No individual cases, tracked products, or MCP servers appear in the record.
